_description: Curated set of high-prominence npm and PyPI packages used as the ONLY reference set for typosquat matching. A candidate import is flagged as a typosquat when it is a single high-signal edit (keyboard slip, homoglyph, adjacent transposition, or non-numeric insertion/deletion) away from one of these names. Matching against a small curated prominent set — rather than the full 10k/15k popularity snapshot — is what keeps precision high: typosquatting attacks deliberately target prominent, high-download packages, so legitimate niche packages that merely happen to be edit-distance-near another niche package are NOT flagged.
_rationale: Empirical: 18% of the names in the full npm popularity snapshot are within Levenshtein <=2 of another DIFFERENT real package (jest/nest, core/code, parser/parse, react-router/reach-router, mysql/mysql2, openai/openapi, ...). Matching against the full snapshot therefore floods the result with false positives on legitimate niche packages. SpellBound (USENIX 2020) likewise found lexical similarity must be combined with a popularity signal to keep the false-positive rate low (they reached 0.5%). Restricting the target set to curated prominent packages achieves 0 false positives on the 8,660 distinct real npm names in the snapshot while retaining full recall on hand-crafted typosquats of those prominent names.

_sources.title: Defending Against Package Typosquatting (SpellBound)
_sources.note: Combined lexical similarity with download counts; 0.5% false-positive rate. Motivates pairing edit-distance with a popularity gate.
likely_real_alternative fields supply the packages attackers actually conflate/typo; the real ones are included here as targets.
Real-world slopsquatting attacks targeted prominent packages (huggingface_hub, jscodeshift, express).

_coverage_notes: These are the npm/PyPI packages most frequently targeted by typo/slopsquat attacks (download leaders + every real likely_real_alternative referenced in hallucinated-corpus.json). The list is intentionally curated and conservative; adding a niche package here is safe only if it is genuinely prominent, because every name here becomes an attractor for the edit-distance matcher.
